## Before Reporting

- Do not include access tokens, recovery codes, passwords, private keys, private room IDs, private homeserver details, or full diagnostic logs.
- If this may involve authentication, encryption, account recovery, private data, or update integrity, report it privately using the [repository security policy](https://github.com/Inter-Galactic-App/Inter-Galactic/security/policy) instead of opening a public issue.
